Trimming used to be my favorite stage of the process but lately something is going wrong and I can’t quite figure out quite what.  I think it’s timing. You’ve got to trim pots at the right stage of dryness. Too wet and they warp, too dry and they dull your trimming tools.  Trimming can vastly change the profile of a pot. Adding a foot can add elegance or playfulness. I also love leaving the swirling marks of the trimming tool on the bottom as a lil reward for anyone who picks up the pot and flips it upside down since I think pots are meant to be interacted with.  #trimming #wheelthrown #oddlysatisfying #oddlysatisfyingvideo #potterytiktok
